family: The single total family f defined in proof.md Section 1: f_0=0; for N>=1 let k be the least prime with k^5>=32N^3, m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); if not (k<N, r>=2, r+2<=k) then f_N=0. Otherwise the input is w=(q_0..q_{k-1},x_1..x_m); q(z)=z^k+sum q_j z^j; if the test T(q) [z^(2^k)=z mod q, q(0)=1, q(1)=1] fails, f_N(w)=0; else, in K=F_2[z]/(q), pad x with zeros into r blocks u_i in polynomial basis, y_i=u_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1), and f_N(w)=Tr(E_t(y_1,...,y_r)), the trace of the t-th elementary symmetric polynomial.
theorem: For this one total family, computable in deterministic polynomial time (hence in NP with the empty witness), C_B2(f_N)>=3N-252*N^(4/5) for every integer N>=2^29 at actual input length N in the full Li-Yang B2 model; hence C_B2(f_N)>=(3-o(1))N at every sufficiently large integer length.
